description: GetApps(com.xiaomi.mipicks) did not correctly verify the parameters passed into the local web page, resulting in the installation of specific applications in the Xiaomi app store, causing some information to leak.The attacker needs to induce the user to move the unlocked mobile phone closer to the malicious NFC tag, so as to secure a specific APP in the mobile phone, which further leads to information leakage.

description: The combination of password can be used to calculate/transmit data is not encrypted/data source is not verified. The use of 3 vulnerabilities, through a man-in-the-middle attack in a specific environment may lead to partial data leakage or malicious file writing.Attackers can easily calculate the password used in the data connection process, intervene in the data transmission process, obtain the transmission content or put the malicious file into the transmission queue.
